title: PCDReading
description: Versioned cavitation-sensing contract for a therapy controller. globalPCD emits this; it never chooses the next pulse.

schema_version.description: Semver of this contract. Controllers should reject unknown major versions.

timestamp.description: Pulse-trigger time in seconds on the controller clock.

status.description: no_reading: do not act (deadline or hard fault). degraded: produced but low confidence or partial.

location_estimate.description: Array coordinates (metres), typically (x, z) or (x, y, z). Null when not computed (single-element ingest).

location_uncertainty.description: Spot-size proxy in metres (e.g. -3 dB), or null.

latency_ms.description: Measured end-to-end compute time for this frame, not assumed.
